Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the productive call last week. Fluxion would like to do an in-person demo at your Novato office the week of Sept 7 — primarily a 2-hour deep dive for our engineering + procurement groups. Two quick asks before we confirm travel:

- What information do you need for visitor clearance (company, DOB, driver license or passport)?
- Can you confirm which conference room we’ll use and whether AV will be available?
- We may need a short mutual NDA/MOA for on-prem access; is DocuSign acceptable?

Proposed time window: Sept 7–9, morning sessions preferred. Aaron and I are flexible.

Best,
Evelyn

Hi Evelyn — great to hear. Sept 7 works for us; I can host. Quick notes:

- I’ve penciled you for Conference Room Orion (2nd floor) — it has HDMI + USB-C AV. I’ll double-check with facilities.
- DocuSign is perfect. I’ll send an MOA for signatures and a calendar invite once we lock time.

Would you prefer a 9:00–11:00 or 10:30–12:30 slot?
